criteria.false: The record shows an ongoing fault spreading across many items, systems or deliveries.

criteria: No look: no violations, no failed checks and no outbound step; nothing needs a person.
Sample glance: a person samples a few items at leisure; no real gap exists.
Scheduled review: a small gap that can wait for the next normal review cycle.
Same-day review: a real gap a person must check today before the run is used.
Immediate stop: an active problem that needs halting now and a person to act.

criteria: No look: every rule check in this run passed, nothing was sent out, and the run finished as completed; any transient errors were retried and the final attempt succeeded, so no failure matters and nothing needs review.
Log only: a rule check failed, or the run's outputs show a difference or anomaly, but the effect is harmless and the only action needed is to write it down.
Spot check: a person samples the run's outputs when convenient, because the outputs carry some uncertainty that a rule check does not settle.
Full review: a person must go through the whole run, because a rule check failed with an effect that matters or an irreversible step was taken.

criteria.close_without_review: Record the run as complete and move on with no human look. Use this when every record was processed, every rule check passed, the expected and actual totals are equal, and nothing was sent out.
criteria.hold_for_second_reader: Keep the run open until a second person reads its results. Use this only when a check failed, a total differs, or an outbound step has happened that needs a human to confirm it.
criteria.reopen_and_rerun: Reopen the run and process its records again. Use this only when some records were not processed or a step did not complete.
